findings.title: External project imports are filtered out before the isolation gate checks them

evidence.collector: {K: str(getattr(V, '__file__', '')) for K, V in sys.modules.items() if getattr(V, '__file__', None) and Path(V.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Base)}
evidence.explanation: In the copied regression process Base is the replay Run. The collector retains only module files already under Base. replay subsequently tests those same retained files against Run. Every outside file is omitted, so this check cannot detect an outside project import. The subsequent gate also lacks a required-name check.

actual_ast_counterexample.kind: real harness logic defect demonstrated on synthetic module metadata, no external read
actual_ast_counterexample.collector_expression: {K: str(getattr(V, '__file__', '')) for K, V in sys.modules.items() if getattr(V, '__file__', None) and Path(V.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Base)}
actual_ast_counterexample.impact: An outside project import is discarded before replay validates module paths, so the empty external_project_modules output is not evidence of isolation. This does not demonstrate an outside import occurred in the actual replay.

findings.impact: The reported empty external_project_modules list is not a valid runtime isolation certificate. No actual external project import was observed or alleged; all displayed expected bindings were local. The defect concerns the submitted scope guarantee, not the successful finite numerical comparisons.
findings.fix_request: Collect project-module provenance before any is_relative_to(Base) filter (or record the complete file-backed module map and classify installed Python/NumPy/SciPy separately). Require each expected project module to be present at its selected originals/candidates path under Run and verify its bound source digest. Add an outside-path/missing-module negative control using synthetic metadata or a locally owned fixture, and rerun normal/-O. Alternatively explicitly withdraw the runtime isolation claim and mark the filtered map as local-bindings-only; do not continue presenting external_project_modules=[] as a checked guarantee. Keep the ten numerical patches unchanged unless separate evidence warrants a change.
findings.resolution_required_for_approval: A new frozen harness or truthful narrowed scope statement must be reviewed; the current snapshot is not approved.

findings.title: Unmodified op03_gap_precise still returns incorrectly weighted-normalized eigenfunctions

coefficient_and_backend_separation.name: op03 independent separation of two original defects

findings.impact: Using actual returned functions in FH gives wrong values even after repairing the paired factor. The tested low roots still agree with IVP shooting; they are not declared faulty solely from reverse multiplication. Local values agree after independent weighted renormalization, isolating the demonstrated normalization failure. op03_gap_fh now correctly imports fixed, so this legacy defect does not invalidate that patch.
findings.fix_request: Retain an explicit exclusion for the legacy backend. Any future separately authorized repair should consistently use P_block @ M for cumulative and point propagation, recompute the norm from the resulting correct block-start state, and verify actual weighted masses and values on asymmetric SUP/INF as well as symmetric cases. Do not silently repair this eleventh file in the present frozen ten-patch review.

limitations: Approval, when granted after R7-SW-001 is addressed, is limited to these ten patches, their bounded behavioral regressions and truthful scope.
No historical Green/resolvent or spectral-summation Jacobian correctness or infinite tail estimates are certified. Their modules can be imported without their routines being executed.
No all-R or full-n scans, branch continuation, global extremum, simple-zero or other global mathematical theorem is certified.
No P1/P2/P3 density-variation derivation, historical proof/certificate, Lean verification or canonical knowledge base was reviewed.
AST expression evaluation with a supplied jac_fd argument is not an end-to-end test of an original main using analytic_jacobian_hp or analytic_jacobian_spectral.
Only op03_gap_fh was run as an actual candidate CLI. Other scripts were exercised via stated functions and exact source AST; historical top-level scans were excluded.
Finite differences are floating point with declared steps and tolerances. Small residuals and agreement are local numerical evidence, not exact analytic zero/regularity proofs.
Only this installed Linux/WSL Python/NumPy/SciPy environment was executed; no Windows/native or full-platform robustness claim.

The first failed required command was caused by reviewer isolation hiding user-site NumPy/SciPy. It was preserved, then the same required argv succeeded with the permitted installed package path explicitly enabled.

The supplied filtered module map cannot certify the absence of additional outside modules. Known recorded module paths were local, and reviewer supplemental full provenance is process-specific; it is not retroactive full provenance for replay.
PACKET is the identity boundary. No live main-tree comparison was performed; author assertions that snapshots match a current main tree are not independently certified.
regression/verify_package.py was inspected but not run because it reads manifest.sha256 and manifest entries not supplied by PACKET. Packet allowlist hashes were independently verified instead.
